proof.scope: Current explicitly reviewed root source types and eight native generation pools on pinned MVID; strict component HP scope remains 2/11. No whitelist expansion in this change.

proof.captureBoundary: Cauldron and other audited reward/capacity callbacks run before stable Play or AfterObtained; closed combat source set cannot obtain relics and therefore cannot reenter them. proof.callbacks: Unknown extension subscribers are refused even if the HP certificate accepts them as non-healing. Existing native inventory getter aliases and callback subscriptions were reviewed, not just Heal text or command names.
proof.costFloor: Actual spent explicit cost + cheapest required distinct still-present initial bottles. Automatic uses consume their physical slot, but do not increase the explicit quota or explicit spent cost. Include protected/unsearchable bottles to keep the floor optimistic.
proof.branchChecks: Slot count/identity/consumed-slot ledger/free-origin flag/pending-choice and finite reviewed source-type witness. Same-ID refill and unknown branch Exhaust refuse. No available cost returns existing conservative fallback; insufficient stock does not introduce a new no-route prune.
proof.noMutableCache: Frozen private root arrays; each cost query reads its own shadow branch. Shared across Fork as immutable metadata; no live HP, inventory, RNG or mutable cross-branch cache.
proof.objectiveGuard: Existing Smart exact-count qualification, complete winning potion-free baseline, no death-save use, forced/theft/growth/relic guards, replacement credit and boss relief remain.
